title: One line a day counts
caption:
One line a day counts as a diary ✏️

Pick a mood, write a single sentence, done. Daily Charm keeps your to-dos, habits, mood and diary in one day, with small charms for company.

Free to start on the App Store (iPhone). Search “Daily Charm”.

#journaling #onelineaday #cozyapps #productivity #dailycharm

veo.prompt: Stop-motion style scene of a small wooden desk with a closed notebook and a mug, and a window on a cream wall. Very subtle motion: a thin wisp of steam rises from the mug, clouds drift slowly in the window. Nothing new appears: no characters, no animals, no people, no objects are added, and nothing moves from its place. Locked-off static camera, no zoom, soft warm even light, calm and cozy.

scenes.small: A mood and a sentence. Done.
